items.briefing:
Online fraud is rising sharply, with new research showing ecommerce fraud pressure has increased 33% as criminals use AI to launch more sophisticated attacks. Australian online shoppers and staff who process payments should be extra cautious about suspicious transactions or unexpected requests for financial details. Separately, research highlights that AI-generated software patches fail around half the time, meaning automated fixes shouldn't be blindly trusted without human review.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected invoice, payment request, or account alert — especially by email — verify it directly with the sender before acting on it.

featured.title: Ecommerce fraud pressure rises 33% as AI fuels attacks
featured.quote: AI-powered ecommerce fraud attacks surged 33%, directly threatening Australian online shoppers and retailers.
